# Display checks do not prove that the manual edit form receives the selected protocol

Entry 1198 tests the visible protocol details and then checks that the manual incoming view opens. Those assertions alone do not prove that its captured model and prefilled protocol match the chosen alternative. For this transition, recommend a separate assertion on captureState or the manual form’s actual selected protocol and server values. The accepted manual form stores the supplied config and starts editing from a copy. This is a proposed test improvement, not a claim that a failing runtime test was observed; the existing tests were read but not executed. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub edit-configuration tests.
